name: Menu
summary: A menu button: a popover menu with the full keyboard model from <lue-menu>.
rungReason: Popover, invoker commands and implicit anchoring open, place and dismiss the menu natively; only the APG keyboard model (arrows, Home/End, typeahead, Tab, focus return) needs <lue-menu>.

a11y.role: menu; items menuitem (menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio stay open on activation)
a11y.name: aria-labelledby → the trigger, or aria-label

states.via: Exposed on the trigger by the browser (popover invoker); not authored

keyboard.action: Open, focus the first item (native button + toggle)
Typeahead; repeating a letter cycles through matches
Close and move on from the trigger

focus.initial: First item (last with ArrowUp on the trigger)
focus.return: The trigger, explicitly (WebKit doesn't restore it)

elementRules: Writes nothing to the DOM: it listens and moves focus. Items carry tabindex="-1" in the markup.

components.MenuItem: a menuitem button with tabindex -1; tone="critical"
components.LueElements: mount once to register <lue-menu> after hydration

react.rule: No portals: the menu stays where it's rendered, so it works inside a dialog

withoutJavaScript: Opens, closes with Esc and light dismiss, and anchors; items are reachable by pointer but not by arrow keys
contrast: Increased contrast and reduced transparency: opaque surface, solid ring
forcedColors: Canvas / CanvasText with a border; hovered and focused items Highlight / HighlightText; separators CanvasText
deletionTrigger: A native menu element with the APG keyboard model (the <menu>/<menuitem> proposals)
